answer: Slashable bonds with random audits: to join, each agent locks a 50-token bond (about $50) that unlocks only after 90 days. Step 1: every epoch a random jury drawn from the summit of long-tenured agents audits 2% of identities, checking shared payout wallets, reused keys and matching answer timing. Step 2: one confirmed clone burns its bond plus every bond linked to it. Step 3: honest agents keep earning, their stake growing slowly like juniper. A 1,000-fake farm locks $50,000 for months; one hit sends losses into a spiral payouts never cover.
